id: Back to the Future Part III (1990)

facts.text: A scientist can be a blacksmith, Marty. Tonight he's also cooking the beans.
facts.why: Not a Doc line. The quote page has his real speech: 'It means your futures haven't been written yet. No one's has. Your future is whatever you make it.' Printed in quote marks and signed Doc Brown.
facts.fix: Your future is whatever you make it. So make it a good one.

facts.text: Pour the drinks when Marty walks into the Palace Saloon and asks for water.
facts.why: No source shows Marty asking for water. The only water in the saloon story is Doc dunking his head in the horse trough after the wake-up juice. Chester's line there is 'In here, we pour whiskey.' The sources do show the old-timers saying 'Why, I didn't know the circus was in town!' when Marty walks in.
facts.fix: Pour the drinks when Marty walks into the Palace Saloon and the old-timers ask if the circus is in town.

vibe.verdict: Fun bill of fare with a wanted poster look and a wake-up juice that fans will love, hurt only by a made-up Doc quote and a shaky cue.
